categoryUrls.description: Yandex News category page URLs (required for browseCategory mode). Use dzen.ru/news/rubric/* URLs. Confirmed working slugs: computers, politics, world, sport, business, science, society, culture, auto, health. Legacy news.yandex.ru/*.html URLs are auto-converted.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

domain.description: Regional Yandex News edition to scrape (via dzen.ru).

language.description: Content language filter. Sets Accept-Language header and Yandex language preference.
language.title: Language

maxStories.description: Maximum number of story clusters to scrape per query or category (1–200).
maxStories.title: Max Stories

mode.description: Scraping mode: search by keyword, browse a category, or get trending stories.
mode.title: Mode
